facts.statement: Laiyangosaurus is classified as a member of the saurolophine tribe Edmontosaurini.
facts.quote: Laiyangosaurus is a member of the saurolophine tribe Edmontosaurini.

facts.statement: Laiyangosaurus belongs to the subfamily Saurolophinae.
Laiyangosaurus is a member of the family Hadrosauridae.
Laiyangosaurus is part of the tribe Edmontosaurini.
Laiyangosaurus youngi is the only known species within the extinct genus Laiyangosaurus.
facts.quote: Laiyangosaurus youngi es la única especie conocida del género extinto Laiyangosaurus

facts.statement: Laiyangosaurus lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, approximately 72 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 72 millones de años durante el Maastrichtiense

facts.statement: The Laiyang Basin area has yielded significant fossil material including insects, plants, vertebrates, dinosaurs, and dinosaur eggs.
facts.quote: Esta área ha producido una considerable cantidad de otros materiales fósiles, incluyendo los restos de insectos, plantas y varios vertebrados, entre ellos dinosaurios y restos de sus huevos.

facts.statement: It is debated whether several specimens referred to Laiyangosaurus actually belong to kritosaurine and lambeosaurine hadrosaurids rather than the genus itself.
facts.quote: A number of specimens referred to Laiyangosaurus (IVPP V23405.1, V23403.1, V23402.1, V23404, V23402.7) apparently belong to kritosaurin and lambeosaurine hadrosaurids.

facts.statement: The time range for Laiyangosaurus is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)
